decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree builds directly on the firm's core cultured-dairy know-how, so management can read its market signals and refine it, although the 2020-2021 website no longer mentions it and that adds some uncertainty.
As a flagship flavored cheese resting on established cheese competence and the firm's own organic milk supply, it is the product management can best interpret and improve, so it stays.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of existing production knowledge, so it is cheap to keep and easy for the firm to learn from.

The mild soft cheese sits in the soft-cheese family where the washed-rind variant already failed, so the firm's thinner knowledge there raises the risk, but the mild style is closer to its competence and is worth keeping for now.
